summary: Ubuntu 17.10 (Artful Aardvark) was the first release to use GNOME Shell instead of Unity. Default session was Wayland. Features: GNOME 3.26, minimal customizations (a few extensions), switch from Xorg to Wayland by default on supported hardware. LibreOffice 5.4. The aardvark symbolized adaptability—Ubuntu 'dug in' to a new direction.
notes: Unsupported since 2018-07-19. Kernel 4.13. Major transition: Unity → GNOME, Xorg → Wayland. Some users had Wayland compatibility issues and switched back to Xorg.
